title: Fraud Detection in Financial Transactions
summary: A fraud detection pipeline on the BankSim credit-card transaction dataset that trains and compares LightGBM, XGBoost, and other classifiers with class-imbalance handling, and exposes a FastAPI scoring endpoint with a Streamlit dashboard. It uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, fit on a detected Metadata schema, to generate synthetic transactions streamed to the API for real-time demo scoring.
evidence: tools/generate_synthetic_data.py:5-26 imports GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, detects Metadata, fits synthesizer on df
